info.title: Restaurant Operations Platform: Vendor Control Plane API
info.description: Generated from @rp/contracts/control-plane by `pnpm contracts:docs`; do not edit by hand. Restaurant PCs call it: `x-capability` is `INSTALLATION` for requests signed with the installation's Ed25519 key (headers x-rp-installation, x-rp-timestamp, x-rp-nonce and x-rp-signature over `signedRequestMessage`, ADR-0012) or `PUBLIC`. `x-requirements` lists the BRD requirement IDs.

put.summary: Escrow the PC’s backup key, wrapped with the vendor’s escrow key
put.description: DATA-003, OI-10: sent when a heartbeat answer offers the escrow key. The Control Plane stores only the wrapped key; unwrapping needs the vendor’s KMS. Audited.

get.summary: The bill behind a digital bill’s link, as a web page
get.description: Public because the diner opens it from the message: the 256-bit token in the link is the credential, and only its hash is stored. An HTML page with no scripts; 410 once the copy has expired and been deleted. Not indexed by search engines.

post.summary: Start uploading the night’s encrypted backup: signed URLs for its parts
post.description: DATA-003: the file is encrypted on the PC with its own backup key; the PC PUTs each part straight to object storage in India. Starting the same file again (same SHA-256) answers COMPLETE with no parts. A PC starts 8 files in 24 hours at most, none dated after the Control Plane’s time.

post.summary: Send a settled bill to the diner on WhatsApp or SMS
post.description: BILL-012, P7-09a: only with the diner’s consent, which the restaurant PC checks before it asks. Sent through the vendor’s provider account (SEC-002) with a link to the bill as printed, kept until `keepDays` have passed. The full number is not stored. The same `id` again answers with the first result and never sends twice; a FAILED one is tried again.

post.summary: Read a printed menu from photos or a PDF (AI-assisted import)
post.description: ONB-006, VCP-008: the files are read by the AI provider, whose key only the Control Plane holds (SEC-002). The answer comes at once with the job; ask for it until it is DONE or FAILED (a menu takes about a minute). The files are deleted once read. What comes back is a draft that a person must check before anything is imported.

get.summary: Download a cloud backup from the development object store
get.description: application/octet-stream. Public because the HMAC-signed grant in the URL is the authorisation, as a presigned S3 URL is: it names one file and expires. Development and tests only (404 in staging and production, which use S3).

403.description: The grant is not valid, not for this, or expired.

put.summary: Upload one part of a cloud backup to the development object store
put.description: Public because the HMAC-signed grant in the URL is the authorisation, as a presigned S3 URL is: it names one part of one upload and expires. Development and tests only: staging and production keep cloud backups in S3, where these addresses answer 404 (the configuration refuses the local store there). The body is the part’s bytes, checked against `Content-MD5` when given.

200.description: Stored; the part’s ETag is in the `ETag` header.

400.description: The part does not match its Content-MD5.

403.description: The grant is not valid, not for this, or expired.

post.description: Chain alerts and failed updates only: the others close by themselves when the PC reports it is fixed. Audited.
